posts.blurb: Off the Kimberley coast the tide drops and 100,000 acres of reef rises 26 feet out of open ocean, waterfalls pouring off every edge. Yowjab is above water about three hours, then gone.

posts.blurb: Three hundred and fifty people lay down in hammocks at a campground in Swan Valley, Idaho and stayed put five minutes. That is two world records. The old marks were 269 and 125.
posts.why: A crowd organizing itself around one absurd shared task, which is roughly what a route full of teams looks like.
